method: RIDB facilities pinned at 0,0 (the 2026-09-21 lower-48 filter dropped them). audit/ridb_gap_zero_2026-09-28.json -> ridb_gap_triage.py --gap -> rec.gov /api/camps/campgrounds/<id> for a real pin (RIDB has none; rec.gov does for most) -> name + pin dedup.

added.name: Idlewild Campground
added.caveat: FS says trailers 20 ft and under; six dated reviews 2020-2026 fit 23-36 ft rigs in 4-5 larger sites

added.name: Walla Walla Forest Camp
added.caveat: no agency length; one 2016 review, 23-ft trailer

added.name: Williamson Campground
added.caveat: no agency length; reviewers fit 23- and 31-ft trailers

added.name: Turkey Flat Forest Camp
added.caveat: no agency length; one 2016 review, 23-ft trailer; rough road past the guard station

added.name: Buck Creek Campground
added.caveat: shared with stock users (hitching rails, loading ramp); FS: 60-ft parking welcomes long RVs
